meta.title: Magazine — Trace of the Tide
meta.description: Shoreline narratives, community voices, and the latest from Trace of the Tide magazine.

hero.title: Shoreline Narratives: Community Voices
hero.standfirst: Stories, essays, and testimonies from the people who carry the tide with them.

quote.text: Good magazines don't simply report the world—they preserve its memory.

upcoming.title: Upcoming issues
upcoming.standfirst: What's being written, funded, and researched right now.

collections.title: Collections
collections.standfirst: Curated groupings across themes and editions.

1.title: Memory, before it fades
1.body: Every tide erases what came before it. We exist to write down what the water would otherwise take — testimonies, oral histories, the small facts of a life.

2.title: Editorial, not algorithmic
2.body: Every piece in these pages passed through an editor who read it, questioned it, and chose it — not a feed that guessed you'd click it.

3.title: Built with the people we publish
3.body: Writers, artists, and archivists across four languages shape this magazine together — the Board you'll meet below is who stands behind every issue.

reading.title: A different way to read
reading.standfirst: Reading here is built around the writing, not around keeping you scrolling.

1.title: Considered typography
1.body: Set for long-form reading, not headline skimming — serif for the story, clean sans for the surrounding chrome.

2.title: Four languages, one voice
2.body: English, Arabic, Spanish, and French, each treated as a first language rather than a translation bolted on after.

3.title: Member-only depth
3.body: Subscriber and paid tiers unlock longer investigations, full issues, and early access to new work.

4.title: Curated collections
4.body: Editors group pieces by theme, place, and moment — so one good story leads you to the next.

5.title: Editorial quality
5.body: Every article is edited, fact-checked where it matters, and read by a human before it reaches you.

6.title: Wherever you are
6.body: Pick up a piece on your phone and finish it on a larger screen later — your place is remembered.

plans.title: Become a subscriber
plans.standfirst: Support independent editorial work and unlock every issue.

shareStory.heading: Share your story
shareStory.standfirst: Every story matters. Help us preserve the collective memory by contributing your personal experiences, testimonies, or knowledge of historical events.
